'''Zakxon Gewchi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was present at [[Tauntaun Ridge]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] around [[3641 BBY]]. <ref name="Date"/>

==Behind the scenes==
Zakxon Gewchi appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a Champion boss on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. He is not directly involved in any quests, however he can be killed for loot and as part of the achievement. This article assumes 100% game completion, which means he was killed.
